title: Slider
description: Range control for selecting one value or a range along a scale, with a rubber-band stretch past the ends, detent marks and a value tag.

c.v: Range control that selects one or more numeric values along a scale. Dragging past either end stretches the track like rubber and springs back with the release speed, the thumb swells while it is held,
adds a value tag that sways with the thumb's speed. It is built on

Dragging the pointer past either end stretches the track toward it with iOS-style resistance, up to 36px however far the pointer goes, and releasing springs it back with the release velocity. The thumb at that end follows the stretch and an icon on that side is pushed outward. Home, End or an arrow key pressed at a limit plays a short stretch and snap. It is off for
, vertical sliders, disabled sliders and reduced motion.

While dragging or pressing the track, a value within about 7px of a mark snaps to it, the tick pops and a short vibration plays where the device supports it. Keyboard steps never snap. Pressing a labelled mark moves the nearest thumb to it (a range stays ordered) and commits.
